_note: Result of the 2026-10-21 US/Canada gross-margin research pass over the 54 non-financial companies without a verified GM (agents, WebSearch only, company filings/IR only). status 'ok' + applied=true were written into data-us/companies_pool_*.json (gm, gmIsVerified, gmFiscalYear, gmSourceUrl). Everything else stays on the pool-median fallback; no_gross_profit_line = the company reports no cost-of-sales/gross-profit concept (utilities, trucking, airlines, lessors, banks/brokers, oil & gas royalty, land...).
